scope: Bounded advisory Redirect3006 URI/required-field handling; pure Go, no persistence.

priority_selection.reason: Batch100 prioritized bounded Redirect3006 with explicit URI grammar, conditional fields and response-budget acceptance.

assertions: Selected ASCII DiameterURI accepts aaa/aaas, Identity DNS-name subset, optional bounded port, tcp/sctp and diameter parameters in order; no resolution or normalization.
Result3006 requires at least one host; usage is an optional singleton0..6; nonzero usage requires singleton Unsigned32 cache time. Zero TTL is valid. Redirect fields on other E results are rejected.
Fixed256 host cap plus configured repetition/count/field/frame and runtime response budgets apply. URI length is capped before copying decoded strings.
Snapshots and accepted responses own host slices/strings and canonicalize absent options. Extra cannot shadow typed Redirect fields.
TCP/TLS under both route policies accepts terminal/agent Redirect answers as one completed attempt, without automatic follow/replay. A later explicit request still uses the configured route.
Combined/Sh/S6c/SGd two-peer duplicate responses retain frozen fields and per-arrival envelopes. Hints do not alter configured duplicate deadlines or slot/byte accounting.

Invalid and oversized Respond attempts remain uncommitted; valid replies can follow. Matched malformed/untrusted/resource answers return ErrInvalidAnswer with no body and stop protocol processing; Close/Wait retires charges.
Public declarations reviewed on Linux/Windows; shared ops9 invalidates prior Bundle fingerprints independently of unchanged generatorv17 and all eleven generated outputs.
Ten bounded fuzz targets, dual-module static/pure/race/cross and finite stress/bench acceptance. No new module version or durable/real-target claim.
